title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Glasgow Competitive Salary + Benefits Full-Time Permanent

A well-established and growing accountancy practice based in the South Side of Glasgow, are seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a payroll professional looking to develop their career within a supportive practice environment, working with a varied portfolio of clients across multiple sectors.

The Role

As Payroll Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering accurate and timely payroll services to a diverse client base. You will be responsible for managing payroll processes whilst ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and maintaining excellent client relationships.

Duties will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls
- Calculating salaries, overtime, bonuses, commissions and statutory payments
- Managing pension contributions and auto-enrolment requirements
- Submitting RTI information to HMRC
- Processing new starters, leavers and payroll amendments
- Handling SSP, SMP, SPP and other statutory payments
- Producing payroll reports and reconciliations
- Responding to client payroll queries in a professional and timely manner
- Ensuring payroll records are accurate and maintained in line with current legislation

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous payroll experience, ideally within an accountancy practice or bureau environment
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation and HMRC requirements
- Experience using payroll software packages
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good communication and client-facing abilities
- A proactive and professional approach to work
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively

Payroll qualifications are advantageous but not essential for candidates with relevant experience.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Flexible and supportive working environment
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to work with a wide range of clients
- Friendly and collaborative team culture
- Long-term career progression opportunities

Apply

If you are an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for your next opportunity with a respected accountancy practice in the Glasgow area, please apply with an up to date copy of your CV or get in touch with Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
Property Manager / Lettings Administrator

Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 DOE
Location: Glasgow
Hours: Monday to Thursday, 9:00am to 5:30pm Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm

About the Opportunity

An established and highly respected residential property business is looking to expand its successful lettings team and is seeking applications from both experienced Property Managers and Lettings Administrators.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a professional and supportive organisation with a strong reputation within the Scottish property market. Whether you are currently managing a property portfolio or providing administrative support within a lettings environment, we are keen to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Acting as a point of contact for landlords, tenants and contractors.
- Coordinating maintenance and repair works.
- Preparing tenancy agreements and associated documentation.
- Supporting tenancy renewals, move-ins and move-outs.
- Managing property compliance and safety certification records.
- Handling customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Maintaining accurate records using property management systems.
- Assisting with rent administration and reporting.
- Supporting the effective management of a residential property portfolio.
- Providing administrative and operational support to the wider team.

We Would Love to Hear From You If You Have:

Property Management Experience
- Experience managing residential properties or a lettings portfolio.
- Knowledge of tenancy legislation and compliance requirements.
- Experience liaising with landlords, tenants and contractors.
- Strong problem-solving and workload management skills.

OR

Lettings Administration Experience
- Previous administrative experience within property, lettings, estate agency or a similar office-based environment.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Experience processing documentation and maintaining accurate records.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.

Essential Skills
- Outstanding attention to detail.
- Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Professional and customer-focused approach.
- Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Competency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Proactive and positive attitude.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable
- Previous experience within residential lettings.
- Knowledge of Scottish residential tenancy legislation and the Private Residential Tenancy (PRT) framework.
- Experience using property management software.
- ARLA Propertymark qualification or willingness to work towards professional accreditation.
- Full UK driving licence.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Ongoing training and professional development.
- Professional qualification support.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- The opportunity to join a well-established and growing business within the Scottish property sector.

Apply Now

Whether you're an experienced Property Manager looking for your next challenge or a Lettings Administrator seeking to advance your career within residential property, we'd love to hear from you. Join a business where customer service, professionalism and employee development are at the heart of everything they do.

title: Social Media & Office Support Apprentice
description:
LAT_56 is a premium bag and luggage brand creating products for work, travel and everyday life. We are seeking a motivated and creative apprentice who will split their time between LAT_56 and Core Facilities, gaining valuable experience across two growing businesses.

This is an exciting opportunity to work towards a recognised apprenticeship qualification while developing practical skills in marketing, business operations, customer engagement and digital technologies. Working alongside experienced professionals from both companies, you'll contribute to real business projects, learn how different organisations operate, and build the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for a successful career.

Job responsibilities:
- Support the planning, creation and scheduling of digital content across social media channels, including TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn
- Become a competent user of CRM, marketing and business systems, ensuring information is maintained accurately
- Assist with the delivery of digital marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness, engagement and customer reach
- Use collaborative technologies such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and other digital platforms to communicate and work effectively with colleagues
- Create basic marketing assets such as social media posts, email content, blogs and promotional materials
- Monitor and report on campaign performance using analytics and marketing tools, identifying opportunities for improvement
- Research market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviours to support marketing decisions and campaign planning
- Contribute creative ideas and support partnerships, customer engagement activities and brand-building initiatives that help achieve business objectives

Required skills:
- Creative mindset
- Ambitious, hardworking and motivated by measurable success
- Confident communicating with people
- Curious and comfortable with social media and digital trends
- Organised, self-directed and eager to learn from experienced colleagues

Working hours: Monday to Thursday 8.30am - 5pm, Friday 8.30am - 4pm

Benefits:
- Coaching and mentoring from experienced marketing professionals.
- Onsite parking
- Pension (if eligible)

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 6.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!

title: Transport Planning Administrator
description:
Transport Administrator / Planner

Details: Central Scotland, Office-Based, Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm
Salary: Up to £32,000 DOE

About the Opportunity

Our client is a well-established and growing organisation operating within the logistics and transport sector. Due to continued growth, they are looking to appoint a highly organised and proactive Transport Administrator / Planner to join their busy operations team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, thrives on organisation, and is looking to build a long-term career within transport, logistics, and operational planning.

Working closely with drivers, customers, and internal teams, you will play a critical role in ensuring transport operations run efficiently while maintaining accurate records and delivering exceptional administrative support.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the planning and coordination of daily transport operations and fleet activities
- Accurately maintain transport records, operational data, and scheduling information
- Process customer orders and ensure all associated paperwork is completed correctly
- Liaise daily with drivers to monitor progress, manage requirements, and resolve issues efficiently
- Maintain clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders to support service delivery
- Manage transport documentation, emails, and administrative tasks in line with company procedures
- Update systems with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
- Assist with operational planning and ensure all activities are completed within agreed timescales

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in an administration, logistics, transport, planning, or operations support role
- Exceptional attention to detail and strong organisational skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word
- Strong communication skills with the confidence to liaise with drivers, customers, and colleagues
- Ability to prioritise workloads and manage multiple tasks within a busy environment
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a willingness to learn
- Experience using transport management systems would be advantageous but is not essential
- Full UK Driving Licence

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £32,000 depending on experience
- Stable Monday-Friday working hours
- Opportunity to develop a long-term career within a growing transport and logistics business
- Supportive team environment with ongoing training and development
- Varied role offering exposure to both operational planning and transport administration

Interested?

If you're an organised and detail-focused administrator looking to develop your career within transport and logistics, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential discussion.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Glasgow
Salary: £28,000 pro rata
Contract: Temporary - initially 6 months
Hours: Part-time, 25 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Working Arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

Pertemps are currently recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team based in Glasgow on an initial 6-month temporary contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented individual with accounts experience who is looking for a part-time role offering hybrid working.

You will be responsible for a range of bookkeeping and accounting duties, including sales and purchase invoicing, direct debit processing and reconciliations, while supporting the wider finance team to ensure the smooth running of the department.

Key Responsibilities
- Raising sales invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Checking and processing purchase invoices.
- Managing monthly direct debits, including setting up new customers.
- Completing invoicing reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Preparing and completing reports within required deadlines.
- Escalating any issues to the Senior Accounts Assistant or Finance Manager as appropriate.
- Supporting colleagues across the finance team to ensure departmental targets are achieved.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring tasks are completed to a high standard.

Skills required:
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Previous experience using Sage would be advantageous, but is not essential.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong numeracy and time management skills.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workloads.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- A salary of £28,000 pro rata.
- An initial 6-month temporary contract.
- Part-time hours of 25 per week, Monday to Friday.
- Hybrid working, with 3 days in the Glasgow office and 2 days working from home.
- The opportunity to join a collaborative finance team and develop your accounts experience.

Pertemps acts as both an employment business and an employment agency.
